# Nedåt i Asien – räntorna fortsätter upp

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

FN Morgon (EFN) morning show: Stockholm fell 1.5% the day before, while the US and Asia saw smaller drops, as oil went above $100 and bond yields kept rising (US 10-year at 4.84%, a three-year high) despite the Treasury stepping up buybacks. The ECB is expected to raise rates. Swedish company news focused on Hemnet halting its share buyback program; the hosts took this negatively and expect the share to fall. The rest was news items: Apple's foldable launch getting a cool reception, Meta buying the Swedish startup Stilla AI, Nintendo falling ahead of a new Zelda game, Tele2 downgraded by BNP Paribas, Fortum upgraded after its Google partnership, and discounted directed share issues at Astor and Climeon.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Buyback halted after one third completed. Hosts expect a negative share reaction as the support buyer disappears and investors question the motive.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts read the halted buyback negatively. The steady support buyer is gone, the company is already questioned, and the vague 'transformative phase' wording may point to operating problems or plans to spend the cash elsewhere. They also criticised the buyback being run from very high price levels all the way down. The stock was already down ~5% to under 80 SEK.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Hemnet clarifies a credible transformation plan
- if the buyback is resumed at attractive valuation levels

> *"Jag får nog negativ kursutveckling. Dels för att det har funnits en stödköpare hela tiden. Sen är det ett bolag som är ifrågasatt."*
